slides.title: Is Your Website Secretly Losing You Customers?
slides.body: Most small business sites miss three basic elements that turn visitors into paying clients. Here is what you need to fix today.

slides.title: One Clear Action
slides.body: Tell visitors exactly what to do next. Put one obvious button like 'Book a Call' above the fold. Don't make them guess.

slides.title: Fast Load Speed
slides.body: If your site takes over 3 seconds to load, visitors leave. Compress your images and remove unused plugins to keep it fast.

slides.title: Mobile First Design
slides.body: Most clients view your site on their phones. Make sure your text is readable and buttons are easy to tap without zooming.
